Package dev.salusa.crypto

Class SequenceFunction<T extends SequenceFunction<T>>

java.lang.Object
dev.salusa.crypto.SequenceFunction<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the instance of this class, used for chained method calls.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
SequenceFunction.SequenceHash, SequenceFunction.SequenceMac
public abstract class SequenceFunction<T extends SequenceFunction<T>> extends Object implements Cloneable
Implementation of SequenceHash and SequenceMac from c2sp.org/sequencehash. Please see the official specification and the Trail of Bits blog post to understand the properties and uses of these functions.

Use the getHash() or getMac() methods to get instances.

    • partialInputProcessed

      public boolean partialInputProcessed()
      Has this object consumed partial but uncompleted input.

      This object has had one of the updatePartial() methods called without a following call to update(). The partial object must be completed before any doFinal() method may be called.
